what: The first live bridge claim and burn on the public test network, both from the web wallet's Bridge tab

imports_by_the_page_code.root_equals: the vault's slot 0 under record slot 11643072 and the root of its Deposit events

imports_note: sent from the page's own prepareClaim (claim.js) by a test account; together 0.0072 LGO

claim.sent_by: the depositor, in the page (the page's gas limit and evidence set)

burn.message: Burn (one denomination, 0.001 ETH, from holder(cid, account))

release: not possible yet: the vault has had no checkpoint candidate since its deployment (its only events are the setup's and the deposit), so no burn root is accepted on Sepolia
watcher: read-only: getBlockRange over LEZ blocks 2279-3749, the bridge program's transactions and their reverted flags
how_to_check: LEZ: getTransaction(tx) names the block; getBlock(block) holds the transaction (its hash is SHA-256 of its borsh bytes) and its reverted list. Sepolia: the deposit transaction's receipt holds the vault's Deposit event (leaf 0).
